title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana + log shipping + alerts for Private installs
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds automated provisioning and configuration of Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki log shipping plus default alerting for Private installs. Includes Helm values templates, Terraform module wiring, Grafana dashboard templates, and upgrade/rollback hooks. No breaking changes to existing configs.
description: Motivation: Private customers need an automated, supported observability stack as part of the private installer (VPC/on-prem). This PR provides opinionated, repeatable defaults for Prometheus, Grafana, and log shipping (Loki + fluent-bit) plus Alertmanager rules and sane alerts. Scope: - Terraform module to wire observability components into the customer's VPC (subnets, SGs, IAM roles / service accounts). - Helm chart additions and values templates under charts/observability to install Prometheus Operator (kube-prometheus-stack) and Grafana with RBAC-compatible dashboards. - Automatic ServiceMonitors and PodMonitors for Redwood components shipped by the installer. - Loki/fluent-bit configuration for log collection with optional S3 archival. - A templated set of Grafana dashboards (app-level latency, token-level cost breakdown, per-model throughput) and default alert rules with severity and escalation bindings. - Upgrade hooks and a simple rollback strategy: pre-upgrade smoke tests, metric-based health checks, and automatic rollbacks when core SLOs (error rate/latency) regress. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module for observability scaffolding (VPC attachments, SGs) - [x] Helm templates and default values for Prometheus/Grafana/Loki - [x] ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor manifests for main services - [x] Grafana dashboard templates + provisioning config - [x] Alertmanager rules and Opsgenie/PagerDuty webhook wiring - [x] Integration e2e private-install test in CI - [x] Docs: private-installer/observability.md with configuration knobs How to use: 1) Add observability = true in the installer config and provide observability.{vpc,subnet,security_group} in Terraform variables. 2) Use values.yaml to set retention, S3 archival, and alert webhook endpoints. 3) For air-gapped installs, set grafana.image.registry and provide dashboards via the local-assets bundle. Testing: Ran full private-install integration in staging (multi-AZ VPC) and exercised upgrade/rollback path. Observability smoke tests assert: Prometheus scrape > 90% targets up, Grafana provisioning success, Loki ingests logs from fluent-bit. Related: Linear ENG-4021 (observability baseline), ENG-3950 (private-installer upgrade flow). Notes: This is opt-in for existing installs; enabling by default is tracked in ENG-4112.

notes: This PR aims to make observability installable and maintainable in private customer environments. Operator/infra teams should review Terraform IAM bindings for their cloud accounts. For air-gapped installs, follow the README to bake images and dashboards into the local-assets bundle. Rollback behavior: installer pre-upgrade smoke runs metrics checks at 30s/60s; if core SLOs degrade > 5% for 2 consecutive probes we trigger helm rollback automatically.
